summary: After a hearing of more than four hours, a school board votes not to lay off any listed teacher and keeps the deficit.
realLife: A school board heard about eighty speakers over four hours, then moved not to dismiss any of thirty-eight named teachers for the coming year. A board member said the feedback changed her position. The district still faced a deficit near twelve million dollars, had found about four million in non-staff cuts and planned to shrink staffing through retirements and unfilled posts; the budget was due in May.
sources: NCTV17 (Naperville, Illinois), 'Naperville District 203 votes down plan to cut teachers after community outcry', March 2026: https://www.nctv17.org/news/naperville-district-203-votes-down-plan-to-cut-teachers-after-community-outcry/
